description: This file provides an implementation of PHP's ctype functions through regex, serving as a polyfill for environments lacking native ctype support. It defines a final class 'Ctype' with static methods to check character properties such as alphanumeric, alphabetic, control characters, digits, printable characters, and more.

classes.name: Ctype
classes.description: A final class implementing ctype functions via regex to simulate PHP's native ctype extension.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the text are alphanumeric (letters or digits).

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the text are alphabetic letters.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if all characters are control characters based on the current locale.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if all characters are decimal digits.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if all characters are printable and create visible output.

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if all characters are lowercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if all characters are printable, including spaces.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if all characters are punctuation characters.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if all characters are whitespace characters.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if all characters are uppercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if all characters are hexadecimal digits.

methods.name: convert_int_to_char_for_ctype
methods.description: Converts integer inputs into their character equivalents for ctype checks, handling special ranges appropriately.
